contractPurpose: One bounded synthetic AWS SES email send; preparation only until this exact digest is approved
preconditions: Human approval matches this contract SHA-256 exactly
AWS_PROFILE is exactly routemind-ses in the execution process
AWS_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION are exactly ap-northeast-1 in the execution process
ROUTEMIND_NOTIFICATION_SENDER and ROUTEMIND_NOTIFICATION_SYNTHETIC_RECIPIENT are present in the execution process
DefaultCredentialsProvider resolves locally before the send without a service call
AWS_PROFILE selects the reviewed shared profile and no conflicting SDK profile override is present
AWS SES sender identity is verified and synthetic recipient is approved for this bounded test
AWS SES account/channel and billing owner are explicitly confirmed
SES remains in the approved account state; no production-access or IAM change is requested
Outbox intent is consent-valid, tenant-scoped, idempotent, and has not already consumed this contract
Budget counters start at zero and the wall-clock deadline is recorded before the request
Leakage scan and redacted evidence sink are ready before any request
No fallback result is substituted for an AWS result
stopConditions: Any contract digest, provider, region, identity source, recipient count, message count, or budget mismatch
Any missing or invalid non-secret configuration or local credential-chain failure
Any attempt to create or mutate an AWS account, IAM policy, SES configuration, or resource
Any sender, recipient, message body, customer data, or credential leakage risk
Any request, recipient, retry, attachment, CC, BCC, or bulk boundary reached
Any wall-clock deadline or USD 0.10 ceiling reached or plausibly exceeded
Unexpected authentication, quota, billing, endpoint, or response semantics
Provider acceptance without the required authenticated delivery evidence
Any fallback or local result that could be mistaken for AWS provider truth
Inability to persist redacted raw and classified outcome evidence

evidenceContract.secretHandling: no credential, sender, recipient, message body, or raw provider token may be persisted; values are represented only by status or digest where explicitly allowed
evidenceContract.providerMetadata: record only redacted status, request correlation, and digest; never credential or raw identity values

outcomeSemantics.PASS: Exactly one bounded SendEmail request is accepted, no boundary is violated, and the required authenticated delivery evidence is recorded; this is synthetic provider validation only, never production validation
outcomeSemantics.PARTIAL: The request is accepted or partially observed but authenticated delivery evidence, cost evidence, or another required evidence item is missing; retain the result and make no delivery claim
outcomeSemantics.FAIL: The request is rejected, times out, violates a boundary, leaks data, or cannot produce a trustworthy redacted artifact; retain the failure and do not retry under this contract
outcomeSemantics.fallback: A deterministic local result may be recorded only with explicit reason and provenance and can never change PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL provider semantics

humanGate.approvalStatementTemplate: I approve R4-422 AWS SES single synthetic send contract by exact SHA-256 digest <DIGEST>, authorize exactly one synthetic SendEmail request in ap-northeast-1 within the 15-minute and USD 0.10 limits, with one recipient, no CC/BCC/attachments/bulk/retry, no AWS account/IAM/provider mutation, and accept the stated evidence and fail-closed semantics.
